2609.30747.title: Beyond the Last Truffula Tree: SustainAI - A Water-Aware, Closed-Loop Framework for Environmentally Accountable AI
2609.30747.paper_summary: As artificial intelligence (AI) becomes embedded in everyday life, its environmental footprint, particularly water consumption remains largely invisible. While energy and carbon impacts are widely recognized, the substantial freshwater demands of data center cooling and electricity generation receive little attention. To address this gap, we introduce SustainAI, a water-aware, closed-loop framework incorporating environmental accountability into AI deployment. SustainAI integrates real-time water metering, a hallucination-aware penalty model, and a water-aware routing algorithm that accounts for regional water stress. Evaluated via Small Language Models (SLMs) extracting health misinformation, results reveal an 11-fold variation in water footprint across geographically distributed data centers (0.0477 mL to 0.5360 mL per inference). Across 1,335 inference runs, the system consumed approximately 399 mL of water but produced only 240 correct outputs, demonstrating that substantial resources are spent on inaccurate responses. Crucially, SustainAI extends beyond technical optimization through a Care by Design lens, framing AI sustainability around relational ethics, regional equity, and ecological stewardship. By combining water monitoring, adaptive accountability, and Care by Design principles, SustainAI provides a practical foundation for integrating ethical care and environmental responsibility into AI infrastructure design and lifecycle management.
2609.30747.paper_summary_zh: 隨著人工智慧 (AI) 融入日常生活，其對環境的影響，特別是水資源消耗，仍然在很大程度上是隱形的。雖然能源和碳的影響已廣泛被認識，但數據中心冷卻和電力生產所需的可觀淡水需求卻鮮有關注。為了解決這一缺口，我們推出了 SustainAI，一個水資源意識的閉環框架，將環境責任納入 AI 部署中。SustainAI 整合了實時水量計量、意識幻覺的懲罰模型以及考慮地區水資源壓力的水資源意識路由算法。通過提取健康錯誤信息的小型語言模型 (SLMs) 進行評估，結果顯示地理分佈的數據中心之間的水足跡變化達 11 倍（每次推理 0.0477 mL 至 0.5360 mL）。在 1,335 次推理運行中，系統消耗了約 399 mL 的水，但僅產生 240 個正確輸出，顯示出大量資源被用於不準確的回應。至關重要的是，SustainAI 不僅限於技術優化，還通過設計關懷的視角，將 AI 可持續性框架建立在關係倫理、地區公平和生態管理的基礎上。通過結合水資源監測、適應性責任和設計關懷原則，SustainAI 為將倫理關懷和環境責任融入 AI 基礎設計和生命周期管理提供了實用的基礎。
